abstract: Mature cystic teratomas, often referred to as dermoid cysts, are the most common germ cell tumors of the ovary in women of reproductive age. The gross pathologic appearance of a dermoid cysts is characteristic. Hair follicles, skin glands, muscle, and other tissues lie within the cyst wall. We present a case of a dermoid cyst ovarian tumor in a 24-your-old patient with a tooth lying on each wall. The mass was laparoscopically removed by ovarian cystectomy.
abstract_ja: 成熟奇形腫は一般に類皮嚢腫とも呼ばれ、生殖年齢の女性に最も多い胚細胞腫瘍です。類皮嚢腫の肉眼像は特徴的です。嚢胞壁内には毛包、皮脂腺、筋肉などの組織が存在します。今回、24歳女性の卵巣腫瘍例を報告します。嚢胞壁の各面に歯が1本ずつ付着していました。腫瘍は腹腔鏡下に卵巣嚢腫摘出術で切除されました。
